inputs.volume_unit: mm^3 as labelled by publisher; not independently recomputed
inputs.missing_value_policy: No global imputation; training-fold median after log1p
inputs.selection: strict M0, positive follow-up, no blocking outcome/surgery flags

configuration.preprocessing: training-fold median and standard scaling for each model
configuration.death_handling: same as baseline; death is censored, not a distant event
configuration.aggregation: Harrell: within-fold pair totals; IPCW: equal-fold mean
